_doc: Coherence/safety reject calibration corpus (confidence axis). Each case carries canned classifier scores and the human label at the shipped defaults (coherence 0.70, safety 0.50). Sections: control (clean in-scope prompts — must NEVER reject), violation (must ALWAYS reject), boundary (near-threshold agreement), known_gap (confident scores on a wrong-task request — the predicate cannot catch these; asserted as accept to document the residual risk, never as a fix).

known_gap.name: confident_but_wrong_task
known_gap.label: accept
known_gap.note: Producer confidence is maximal yet the request needs a different capability — the confidence-axis predicate cannot see task-value. Tracked, not fixed, by this milestone.
